description: Production MIPSYNC full-screen co-op shop, ordinary two-controller input and fresh-process memory-card recovery.

shop_fixture.resume_scope: Same normal production disc and persisted memory card in separate emulator processes; only ordinary controller inputs are written.

behavior: An ordinary co-op battle earns11gold; no injected wallet, roster or save state.
Both controllers see their own hero and may independently select goods.
Both purchase prompts initially select Back. Same-frame confirmation buys a tonic for each hero: gold7, Aren3/3, Mira2/3, finite stock0.
Full-pack/sold-out retries leave gold, packs and stock unchanged.
P1 marks Ready while P2 continues shopping and buys unlimited focus: gold4, bothpacks3/3; P1 readiness is preserved.
Fresh-process Continue restores exact purchases and resets transient readiness. P1Ready alone stays in the shop; P2Ready begins the actual next battle.
limits: Emulator validation; no hardware or new performance claim.
Full five-stage demo playthrough remains pending.
This shop is between battles; on-map merchants and selling remain future work.
